title: News and screen: who makes the story
note: B1 Oxford-gap leaf · the people and parts of a story in print, then the same on screen · 12 items · carriers via use[] · picture intro · Use bank

intro.title: The same story, printed and filmed
intro.title_cz: Tentýž příběh — v novinách a na obrazovce
intro.body: Every story reaches you twice, and the two halves of this pack are the two routes. On paper there is a headline, an editor and a reader; on screen there is an episode, a host and a viewer. The words differ, the jobs are the same.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: the press means newspapers and the journalists who write them, not the verb to press — it is always the with no plural.
intro.note_cz: the press = tisk (noviny a novináři), ne sloveso tisknout; vždy s the a bez množného čísla.
